title: Auditing an abductive cross-domain historical hypothesis
japanese_title: 分野横断型の歴史仮説を監査する
summary: A scoped EGM-style Jomon / Dotaku / Kiki case that keeps observations, inferences, risks, falsifiers, and narrative conflicts separate.
user_input: 現代日本人における縄文系父系D-M55の残存、弥生後期の銅鐸祭祀の終焉、記紀神話に見られる降臨・国譲り・農耕起源構造は、後期弥生から古墳初期にかけての社会再編を検討するための分野横断的な作業仮説として扱えるかもしれない。
reason_for_tier: The central hypothesis is framed as a working cross-domain hypothesis. Observations are A-level, inferences are B-level, vulnerabilities are C-level, and explicit overclaim paths are X-level risks.
audit_notes: Main public history/humanities demo. Legacy stronger HTML remains only as stress-test/UI reference.
key_warning_theme: Cross-domain abductive hypothesis; myth and genetics are not direct proof.

nodes.claim_text: Archaeological syntheses describe discontinuity or termination in Dotaku ritual practice around the Late Yayoi to early Kofun transition.

nodes.title: D-M55, Dotaku discontinuity, and Kiki structures may be compared as traces of social reorganization
nodes.description: Jomon-associated paternal-lineage persistence, Dotaku ritual discontinuity, and Kiki mythic structures may be examined as potentially connected traces of Late Yayoi to early Kofun social reorganization.
nodes.reason_for_tier: Cross-domain connection is plausible enough to audit but not proven; it needs ancient DNA, chronology, text-critical, and narrative tests.
falsification_conditions: Kofun elite ancient DNA does not show elevated D-M55.
Dotaku discontinuity can be fully explained by internal ritual chronology.
Kiki motifs can be fully explained by broader myth typology.

nodes.title: Social advantage mechanism is not directly proven
nodes.suggested_patch: State the mechanism as a research question and require direct burial, kinship, or elite-context tests.

nodes.title: Dotaku discontinuity may have internal chronology explanations
nodes.suggested_patch: Keep internal ritual transformation as an explicit competing explanation.

nodes.title: Myth-to-history correspondence is not direct evidence
nodes.suggested_patch: Use Kiki motifs as narrative evidence only, not direct event record.

nodes.title: Continental event bridge remains speculative
nodes.suggested_patch: Require an explicit bridge source before connecting continental events to the Japanese case.

nodes.title: X-risk: Y-DNA proves conquest
nodes.suggested_patch: Never let modern paternal-lineage frequency prove conquest without independent ancient and archaeological evidence.

nodes.title: X-risk: comparative examples prove the Japanese case
nodes.suggested_patch: Treat comparisons as heuristic analogy only.

nodes.title: X-risk: Dotaku sphere was definitively an immigrant group
nodes.suggested_patch: Keep Dotaku social identity open unless supported by direct evidence.

nodes.title: Kofun elite ancient DNA lacks elevated D-M55
nodes.required_test: Compare securely contextualized elite Kofun male lineages against the predicted paternal-lineage pattern.

nodes.title: Dotaku discontinuity fully explained by internal ritual chronology
nodes.required_test: Show a complete local chronology that explains discontinuity without broader social reorganization.

nodes.title: Kiki motifs fully explained by broader myth typology
nodes.required_test: Demonstrate that descent, land transfer, and agricultural motifs follow widespread mythic typology without local historical signal.
